bio.text: Phil Weiser has been Colorado's attorney general since 2019 and is serving his second term; he is the Democratic Party candidate for governor in 2026.
Before becoming attorney general he was dean of the University of Colorado Law School and served as a law clerk to U.S. Supreme Court Justices Byron R. White and Ruth Bader Ginsburg.
He also held senior positions in the U.S. Department of Justice in the Clinton and Obama administrations, and lives in Denver.
